text: script converts CZI files folder raw_data folder ome-tiff, one file per scene (macOS Linux): Windows (PowerShell), files one scene :
code: export JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-Duser.language=en -Duser.country=US" export BF_MAX_MEM=4g mkdir -p ome-tiff  for f in raw_data/*.czi; do   name=$(basename "$f" .czi)   n=$(showinf -nopix -noflat -no-upgrade "$f" | sed -n 's/^Series count = //p')   if [ "$n" = "1" ]; then     bfconvert -noflat -bigtiff -compression LZW -no-upgrade "$f" "ome-tiff/$name.ome.tif"   else     for i in $(seq 0 $((n - 1))); do       bfconvert -noflat -bigtiff -compression LZW -no-upgrade -series "$i" "$f" "ome-tiff/${name}_s$((i + 1)).ome.tif"     done   fi done $env:JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS = "-Duser.language=en -Duser.country=US" $env:BF_MAX_MEM = "4g" New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force ome-tiff | Out-Null  Get-ChildItem raw_data -Filter *.czi | ForEach-Object {   bfconvert.bat -noflat -bigtiff -compression LZW -no-upgrade $_.FullName "ome-tiff\$($_.BaseName).ome.tif" }
